lessons.titleEn: stay in control of the change

brief.meaningEn: Keep meaningful influence over how a transition is planned and carried out.
brief.meaningZh: 在變革的規劃和推行過程中，持續保有實際影響力。
brief.grammar: Use stay in control of the change with the people guiding a specific transition as subject; it expresses meaningful agency, not total control of every result.
brief.register: Practical change-management language: a team lead, staff representative or organiser discusses a transition with colleagues affected by it.
brief.boundaryZh: 需能參與決定、調整步驟或提出回饋；只被通知或被迫適應，不算掌握變革。
brief.misconceptionZh: 保有主導權不等於能保證所有結果，也不等於拒絕任何改變。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出團隊透過哪些具體決策與回饋，保有對變革的實際影響。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 162, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Training helps staff stay in control of the change.
sources.expression: stay in control of the change

listening.en: The workshop is replacing its paper rota with a shared calendar. Staff first test it on one shift, report problems and vote on the final layout. Those choices help them stay in control of the change.
listening.zh: 工作坊正把紙本更表改成共用行事曆。員工先在一個班次試用，報告問題，再表決最後的版面；這些決定讓他們在變革中保有主導權。
listening.promptZh: 員工怎樣 stay in control of the change？

options.en: They test the calendar and help decide how it will be used.
options.zh: 他們試用行事曆，並參與決定使用方式。

options.en: They receive the new schedule only after every choice is final.
options.zh: 所有決定落實後，他們才收到新時間表。

options.en: They prevent the workshop from changing any schedule at all.
options.zh: 他們阻止工作坊更改任何時間表。

options.en: They know exactly what every future problem will be.
options.zh: 他們準確知道將來會出現的每個問題。

listening.explanationZh: 先試用、回報並參與決定，讓員工對推行方式有實際影響；這不是拒絕改變或保證結果。

reply.promptZh: （團隊如何面對即將更改的服務流程？）

options.en: They are piloting one stage and collecting staff feedback.
options.zh: 他們正試行一個階段並收集員工意見。

options.en: They keep the right to adjust the timetable as problems emerge.
options.zh: 遇到問題時，他們仍可調整時間表。

options.en: They stay in control of the change by reviewing each stage before it expands.
options.zh: 他們在擴大推行前檢視每個階段，從而掌握變革的主導權。

options.en: They let the affected staff help decide the next step.
options.zh: 他們讓受影響的員工參與決定下一步。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述團隊如何參與流程更改；金句使用本課表達，概括這種持續的決策權。
reply.promptEn: How is the team handling the coming change to its service process?

scene.promptZh: 一間劇院改用流動售票。前台員工提出先在週末試行、每週檢視投訴，再決定何時全面推行。哪句最完整描述他們的角色？

options.en: Staff can stay in control of the change by setting trial and review points.
options.zh: 員工可訂立試行和檢視時點，從而掌握變革的主導權。

options.en: The new system may reduce the time spent printing tickets.
options.zh: 新系統或許會減少列印門票所需的時間。

options.en: The staff have been told the system will arrive next month.
options.zh: 員工已獲通知系統將於下月推出。

scene.explanationZh: 節省列印時間和獲知日期都可能是真的，但未說明員工如何影響試行與推行。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不符合 stay in control of the change？

options.en: Volunteers test a new rota, suggest changes and approve the next version.
options.zh: 義工試用新更表、提出修改並審批下一版。

options.en: A manager announces a fixed policy after launch and allows no feedback.
options.zh: 經理在推出後宣布不可更改的政策，也不接納意見。

options.en: Staff review weekly results and can pause the rollout if errors appear.
options.zh: 員工每週檢視結果，若出現錯誤可暫停推行。

contrast.explanationZh: 單方面宣布且沒有回饋或調整渠道，受影響者難以保有實際影響。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「新登記方法已定，我們能做的只剩照辦嗎？」你知道仍可選擇試行範圍並每週修改。哪句最合適？

options.en: We can stay in control of the change by choosing the pilot group and revising the process each week.
options.zh: 我們可選定試行組別並每週修改流程，藉此掌握變革的主導權。

options.en: We may not choose the system itself, but we can still report which steps cause delays.
options.zh: 我們未必能選系統本身，但仍可回報哪些步驟導致延誤。

options.en: We should document the delays before deciding how widely to use the new method.
options.zh: 決定擴大使用新方法前，我們應記錄延誤情況。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句提出有用的回報和記錄方式，但金句同時指出團隊仍可決定試行範圍並持續調整。

speaking.en: A small trial and regular feedback help the team stay in control of the change.
speaking.zh: 小規模試行及定期回饋，幫助團隊在變革中保有主導權。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出團隊怎樣影響推行過程。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區運動會要由固定場地改成輪流使用三所學校。義工擔心交通和器材安排。籌委會讓義工試行一個週末、提出修訂，並在每月會議決定下一個場地。用一至兩句英文說明他們如何仍能掌握這項變動，而非只是被動接受。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出試行、提出修訂及參與決定下一個場地的具體作用；不要說義工能控制所有意外結果。

examples.en: The volunteers can stay in control of the change by testing one weekend, reporting equipment problems and helping choose the next school site.
examples.zh: 義工先試行一個週末、回報器材問題，再參與選擇下一所學校場地，便能保有對這項變動的實際影響。

examples.en: By reviewing transport issues each month and voting on the next venue, the volunteers stay in control of the change instead of simply accepting a fixed rotation.
examples.zh: 義工每月檢視交通問題，並表決下一個場地，便能掌握變動的主導權，而非只接受固定的輪換安排。

takeaways.en: Feedback helps people stay in control of the change when it can alter the next step.
takeaways.zh: 回饋若能改變下一步，就能幫助人們掌握變革。

takeaways.en: A trial lets volunteers stay in control of the change without promising a perfect result.
takeaways.zh: 試行讓義工保有對變革的影響，但不保證結果完美。
